selection_basis: Instructor allowed the team to choose its own standard sound; the existing local chirp asset is selected.
standard_event_definition: ten identical 50 ms 2->6kHz chirps at 0,2,...,18 s; mono peak 0.5
playback_device: fixed external player chosen by the team; record model/volume/position per trial

recognition_evidence.last_observed: 2026-10-27 compatibility fallback: single 50ms chirp at t=0; dual-chirp experiment rejected for current detector
recognition_evidence.scope: template correlation on the selected standard sound is not yet accepted; event energy/TOA diagnostic path must not be reported as standard recognition

scope: Software/asset selection only; no hardware, synced two-board, accuracy or course-score verification is implied.
